description:
Exquisite Hachita Build on a Large (57cm) frame (send a request for a different size frame)

Wheels are Pacenti carbon gravel hoops with a dt350 front and dt240 rear hub. Laced with our raw brass nipples and sapim spokes. Perfectly balanced by our expert wheelbuilder joe

Campy Ekar gravel cranks. Flatop chain. Add gears, or don't.

Thomson post. Specialized fast person saddle.

Super light lugged steel bike. Rides like nothing else. I dare you to ride this and not haul ass
